history.name: Generating the documents
history.description: `ledger build` writes the documents and the client's edition, together or one at a time, into the project's output directory or anywhere else asked for. It is run by hand, when someone needs a fresh copy and always when a release is presented — the record is the thing that's kept, and the documents are made from it on demand.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/build.mjs — cmdBuild; --md / --pdf select, --out overrides the directory. Shape rules are enforced here as errors, so a badly shaped record can't be printed.
